name: Ricardo Álvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines in his grandfather's small garage in Buenos Aires. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in quality assurance, and quickly found work with a local racing team. After several successful seasons, he was scouted by Signature Racing for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to identify potential issues before they become critical failures.

Ricardo approaches his role with a blend of technical expertise and a keen understanding of the pressures within a race team. He believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement, constantly seeking innovative solutions to enhance the reliability and performance of the team's equipment. His colleagues appreciate his direct approach and unwavering commitment to excellence.

What sets Ricardo apart is his knack for spotting subtle anomalies in data and equipment. He has an uncanny ability to anticipate problems, often averting disasters before they occur. His sharp eye and dedication make him an invaluable asset to the Signature Racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Argentine coffee to start his day.
